corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Col 4 L26 shows the final character of the verb is በ (two legs, no middle prong), reading ተካሰበ ('he procured/obtained [the emissary appointment]').
Both the printed glyph in Col 4 L28 and canonical Ge'ez Acts 9:2 read ውቁሐኒሆሙ ('bound/fettered', from ወቀሐ / ውቁሕ), where Stage 1 misread the initial 6th-order ው as መ.
